title: Episode 78 Conclusion and Episode 79 Opening — Singhs Who Accepted Martyrdom

blocks.text: This boundary page first closes the brick-and-mortar house episode by showing that obedient trust in the Guru unexpectedly yields material restoration. The reward is not just a rebuilt dwelling but proof that divine care may arrive through radical surrender rather than through ordinary planning.

The narrative then pivots into a new question: how the title martyr became associated with the Singhs. Guru Gobind Singh seated at Damdama hears the complaint about declining faith and is asked to reveal what true steadfastness still looks like in the dark age.
Because of that turn, the page is both conclusion and provocation. Domestic blessing gives way to a test that will separate nominal attachment from willingness to die in obedience.
